seed: Editing a title never starts playback, and every part of it can be clicked with the Select tool, at Next defaults with no switch touched: a Stacked Stagger title page put on a new track over the recording, its headline typed and finished with Command Return. Nothing plays and the playhead stays on the title's held moment; the headline stays picked inside the title. A click picks the subtitle, a double click re-words it, a click picks the accent mark, Escape steps up to the whole title, Energy changes without playing, and the Part section's Replay plays just the second line.

steps.comment: Inserting parks the playhead where every part has arrived, 1.85 s into this title.
Command Return finishes the words: nothing plays, the playhead has not moved.

steps.note: The headline typed and finished with Command Return: nothing plays, every part of the title is on screen, and the headline stays picked with the Select tool in hand

steps.comment: One click on the subtitle, with the pointer on its face, picks the subtitle.

steps.note: One click on the subtitle picked it: its own Part section shows, and nothing played

steps.comment: A double click on the subtitle opens its words.

steps.note: The subtitle re-worded to Out on Friday by double clicking it, and still nothing plays

steps.comment: One click on the accent mark picks it.

steps.note: One click on the small square accent picked it, with its own Part section

steps.comment: Escape steps up from the part to the whole title.
Held whole, a click on it keeps the whole title, so it can be dragged as one.
A new Energy shows on the still title: nothing plays.

steps.note: Escape stepped up to the whole title; Energy set to Punchy and the title held still, nothing played

steps.comment: Escape again lets go of the title, so the next click reaches a part again.
The Part section's Replay plays just this part when asked.

steps.note: The second line played its own in, every other part held still, and the title settled back with every part arrived

steps.comment: Let go of the part; a right click on the title on the canvas is about the whole title.
Replay Title, from the title's clip, plays it when asked.
